verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a reasonable thing to ask of an ML hub platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. What it does show is adjacent: an Inference Providers API, a chat-completion playground for comparing models, and an hf CLI Skill for external coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor. None of these is a native assistant acting inside Hugging Face.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
